endorsements.name: Mishel Kwon
endorsements.label: Meet the Feds 2 - Policy
endorsements.description: Did you ever wonder if the Feds were telling you’re the truth when you asked a question? Join current and former federal agents from numerous agencies to discuss cyber policy and answer your burning questions. Enjoy the opportunity to grill ‘em and get down to the bottom of things! Agencies that will have representatives include: Defense Cyber Crime Center (DC3), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), United States Computer Emergency Readiness Team (US CERT), Office of the Secretary of Defense Networks and Information Integration (OSD/NII), National Security Agency (NSA), National Defense University (NDU), and Virginia Tech. Each of the agency reps will make an opening statement regarding their agencies role, and then open it up to the audience for questions.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
